notes.key_messages: To succeed in this paper candidates need to have completed full syllabus coverage, apply correct methods, remember all necessary formulae, show all necessary working clearly and use a suitable level of accuracy.
notes.general_comments: The vast majority of candidates could access most of the questions. It is important, however, that candidates need to understand the correct form for answers - probability should not be written as a ratio and vectors should not contain a fraction line.
